items.title: Right of withdrawal (Widerrufsrecht) expires
items.quote: Sie können Ihre Bestellung binnen vierzehn Tagen widerrufen, ohne Gründe zu nennen. Die Frist läuft ab dem Tag, an dem Sie die Ware erhalten haben.
items.computation: Goods were delivered on 18.11.2026 (Wednesday), as stated in the letter ('den Esstisch ... geliefert ... am 18.11.2026'). Per § 187(1) BGB, since the period starts upon an event occurring during a day, the day of delivery itself is not counted; the 14-day period begins on 19.11.2026. Counting 14 days under § 188(1) BGB: 19.11. is day 1, ... day 14 falls on 02.12.2026 (Wednesday). 02.12.2026 is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in Bavaria, so § 193 BGB does not shift the date. The withdrawal must be sent (postmarked/transmitted) by this date to be timely ('Rechtzeitig ist der Widerruf, wenn Sie ihn vor Fristende absenden').

warnings: The invoice amount (3.034,00 €) is stated as already paid ('bereits bezahlt'), so no further payment is required from this letter; treat any later demand for the same amount with suspicion.
This is a standard consumer right-of-withdrawal notice (Widerrufsbelehrung), not an administrative legal-remedy instruction, so no Einspruch/Widerspruch/Klage applies.
